name: 2022-2c-recuperatorio-parcial2
title: Qatar OnLine: Goals and Offside
description: Starting from the course staff's Qatar OnLine football game (20x20 board, three player kinds per team, alternating turns, die-adjusted moves and kicks, possession match-ups), the student must add, with TDD, kicking at goal (#patearAlArco, with per-kind scoring rules, goal reset and goal counting) and offside calling by 1 to 3 biased referees whose favoritism and die rolls yield a chance compared with a per-kind threshold.

design.notes: Kick rules and offside thresholds differ per player kind and should be dispatched, not if-ed; the given model keeps players as keys of per-team Dictionaries with no Team object, so goals per team, opposing goal position and 'ahead of all opponents' (allSatisfy:/inject: over players and referees) push toward introducing Equipo and Arbitro; goal and offside outcomes reset positions and possession, extending the turn/possession state.
